import json,sys,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import polars as pl
from polars.testing import assert_frame_equal
from ibex_polars import IbexEngine
sys.path.insert(0,'/home/brj/code/polars-benchmark')
from queries.polars.q22 import q
root=Path('/home/brj/code/polars-benchmark/data/tables/scale-10.0');tables={p.stem:pl.scan_parquet(p) for p in root.glob('*.parquet')};query=q(**tables)
source=IbexEngine().explain(query)
baseline=json.loads(Path('python/pdsh-performance-results/all22-eight.json').read_text())['queries']['q22']['native_source'];assert source==baseline
customer=tables['customer'].with_columns(pl.col('c_phone').str.slice(0,2).alias('cntrycode'))
regex=customer.filter(pl.col('cntrycode').str.contains('13|31|23|29|30|18|17')).select('c_custkey','c_acctbal','cntrycode').collect(engine='streaming')
member=customer.filter(pl.col('cntrycode').is_in(['13','31','23','29','30','18','17'])).select('c_custkey','c_acctbal','cntrycode').collect(engine='streaming')
assert_frame_equal(regex,member)
prefix = tables['customer'].filter(pl.any_horizontal([
    pl.col('c_phone').str.starts_with(code) for code in ['13','31','23','29','30','18','17']
])).with_columns(pl.col('c_phone').str.slice(0,2).alias('cntrycode')).select('c_custkey','c_acctbal','cntrycode').collect(engine='streaming')
assert_frame_equal(regex,prefix)

avg=regex.filter(pl.col('c_acctbal')>0)['c_acctbal'].mean()
orders=tables['orders'].select('o_custkey')
original=regex.lazy().join(orders,left_on='c_custkey',right_on='o_custkey',how='anti').collect(engine='streaming')
filtered=regex.filter(pl.col('c_acctbal')>avg)
early=filtered.lazy().join(orders,left_on='c_custkey',right_on='o_custkey',how='anti').collect(engine='streaming')
late=original.filter(pl.col('c_acctbal')>avg)
assert_frame_equal(early.sort('c_custkey'),late.sort('c_custkey'))
